sections.label: head
sections.text:
Lips dry. Nausea especially from sweets. Dull
headache. Stiff neck and rheumatic pain down left
shoulder and arm. Itching in arms, palms and face.
I.oose stools with gripings in abdomen. Hyper-
active peristalsis, tenesmus aftet stool. More urine
passed. Cough scratchy, wheezy. Thick, yellow mucus
from chest. Feels weak, dizzy and a tired feeling.
